+## Week of October 19, 2026
+
+### App management
+
+#### Unlimited licenses for Apple volume purchase program (VPP) apps
+
+You can now assign VPP apps with unlimited licenses from Apple Business and Apple School Manager, making it easier to deploy apps across your organization without managing license quantities.
+
+Applies to:
+
+- iOS/iPadOS
+- macOS
+
 ## Week of October 12, 2026
 
 ### Advanced capabilities (formerly "Microsoft Intune Suite")

englishSummary.headline: Unlimited licenses for Apple VPP apps
englishSummary.summary: Intune now supports assigning Apple Business and Apple School Manager VPP apps with unlimited licenses on iOS/iPadOS.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Administrators can deploy these apps across their organizations without managing license quantities.
